text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So many...! That's incredible, way to go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I'll cherish it. After all the 
trouble you went through to win it—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right, where should I put them... 
By my pillow, then on the desk, and then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, let's decorate the Trainer's Room with 
one too. To match... I mean, to 
commemorate today!
